dfefd6cded882832e1351825ed28d4c2b6945e05.QuestDescription: The Scourge are at Gjalerbron and they have necromancers with them! They must be working to bring the vrykul into Arthas' fold.$B$BI want the leader of these necrolords eliminated!$B$BDo whatever it takes, $N, but see to it that Necro Overlord Mezhen, and whatever he's attempting to accomplish, is neutralized.$B$BI will not see the vrykul successfully allied with the Scourge!$B$BLook for Mezhen on the platform in the rear right section of Gjalerbron.

dff0b35f0a920aa545fc25e563f1ea029a20ac59.RewardText: Teronis' body lies broken atop the island. For some unknown reason, the murlocs have left it alone.$B$BThe deep slashes across his corpse obviously came from the weapons and claws of the murlocs.

dff1ab8d2e8b57fc8062619cfb2b8aaea1ec3cc5.LogDescription: Slay 4 Rotlimb Marauders and 4 Darkwraiths and return to Ranger Sareyn at Fairbreeze Village in Eversong Woods.
dff1ab8d2e8b57fc8062619cfb2b8aaea1ec3cc5.QuestDescription: We've experienced a marked increase in Scourge attacks, $N.  Our defenses are barely holding and there's no sign of reinforcements from Silvermoon City.  Lend us a hand in defending the village by thinning the numbers of the undead roaming the Dead Scar nearby.
